name: Developer incentives

subjectOf.text: The Shasper canary network is designed as an experimental environment for developer teams that want to move fast and innovate, or to prepare deployments destined for the Casper Network.
subjectOf.abstract: The Shasper Network creates an experimental development environment for dev teams who want to move fast and innovate on Shasper or prepare for deployment on Casper.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hybrid Secure Proof of Stake (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3931933
scope_conditions: canary network running parallel to the Casper testnet and mainnet

subjectOf.text: The Shasper network extends the Casper testnet in a way that benefits community experimentation and creates significant developer incentives that help retain talent for the Casper network.
subjectOf.abstract: The Shasper network provides a natural extension of the Casper testnet which benefits community experimentation. It creates significant developer incentives which helps retain talent for the Casper network.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hybrid Secure Proof of Stake (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3931933
scope_conditions: Shasper deployed as a canary network alongside Casper
